notes.title: Update V1.4
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40863214/910c5d1472dcb08e42b19f3fc7fd0479b7a09e90.jpg[/img]

[h1]Westhunt - Update v1.4 Patch Notes[/h1]

We're excited to finally share with you the biggest and best updates in the West! Check below for our new features and bug fixes.

[h2]New Features:[/h2]

[h3][b]4v4 Mode (Custom Rooms Only)[/b][/h3]
Experience the intense action in our brand-new 4v4 mode, available exclusively in custom rooms. Gather your friends or team up with players from across the globe to conquer the Wild West in your own private showdowns.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40863214/43a6d5b2ec832e662b293dc5d5a71848a9ca4144.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Daily Login Rewards Enhanced[/b][/h3]
Each day brings new treasures! Just for logging in, you can now receive a variety of items to enhance your gameplay. Expect exclusive skins, sprays, and pets among your rewards.
Make sure to log in daily and collect your bounty to stand out in the crowd!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40863214/f954349eaee2d0d4df68b3d3115882e49295a5bd.jpg[/img]

[h2]UI Updates: [/h2]

We've revamped the user interface for room creation, loading screens, and game over screen to support the new 4v4 mode, making it easier and more intuitive to set up your game exactly how you like it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40863214/2d50ff1bcbbd3b985b72acc0ecdc6eeb6a53c503.png[/img]

Enhanced Game Over Screen: The game over screen now includes a new kill log, allowing you to see who landed the most shots and caused the most collateral damage. Analyze your game and plan your next move with better insights!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40863214/1529c4960841f0607aca1cf3ca0cd945eb737e54.png[/img]

[h2]Bug Fixes: [/h2]
We've dedicated this patch to crushing some pesky bugs hindering your gameplay.
Thanks to your invaluable feedback, we've implemented several fixes to enhance game stability and performance. 
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where outlaws could be detected through the outlines of other objects, ensuring a fairer stealth experience for all players.
[*]When the custom setting "Disable Sheriff's Outline" is enabled, the sheriff's icon will no longer appear on the minimap, maintaining the element of surprise in gameplay.
[*]Plus several minor bug fixes to enhance game stability and performance based on your feedback.
[/list]

Thank you for playing West Hunt! We are dedicated to continuously improving the game and value your support and feedback. 

Keep it coming and happy hunting!
- The West Hunt Development Team

notes.title: Update V1.3: Halloween Update!
notes.content:
🎃Howdy Partner and Happy Halloween 🎃


We have unleashed some Wild West Wickedness on our unsuspecting settlement. The West Hunt Town Map looks like a [b]Haunted Town[/b] full of surprises ◥(ºᵥᵥº)◤

[h2]New Haunted Town Map[/h2]
Our main freakish feature; We have completely changed the regular town map to be a Haunted Town! Explore and enjoy the new mood, music, ambient sounds, and decor. 
[i]The other maps will still remain playable, but this map is where all the Halloween Fun has been unleashed.[/i]

[h2]New Halloween DLC[/h2]
In order to lift your Spirits we also have a new devilish DLC for your perusal!
Discover a new Spooktakular Sheriff skin and more:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2643070/West_Hunt_Halloween_Pack2/

[h2]In the Afterlife[/h2]
Even more spectre-culer surprises! When you die as an Outlaw in the Haunted Town you become a ghost! As said ghost, you can walk through walls and keep disturbing the Sheriff. What boo-tiful antics will you pull with your phantasm-ic friends?

[h2]Find the Easter egg and win an exclusive Item[/h2]
Lastly, We know it’s not Spring, but we have a little Easter Egg Hunt for our seasonal Haunt. Somewhere on the map is a hidden easter egg specially placed by our devious devs. Find it and claim the reward… if you dare 🧟‍♂️

[h2]Twitch drops have been enabled[/h2]

We hope you’re just as excited for these new features as we are! To get you even more hype, Check out the full updated trailer :

https://youtu.be/RBfuyBmKuco

─── ⋆⋅☆⋅⋆ ──
Wishing you a Halloween filled with tricks and treats. Don’t forget to join us in our Discord for announcements and giveaways, and join our Publisher Wandering Wizard for their Hallo-week Double Feature Raffle and Sale. Find more details on the Wandering Wizard Discord Server! https://discord.gg/uBraau5anJ 

Stay tuned for more updates soon 🎮

notes.title: West Hunt Update V0.8
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40863214/6e7b3a3ab7ffc19c703df7abfe0a9c9a5ac78145.jpg[/img]
Howdy Partners!

Happy Thanksgiving! 

Let's take a quick look at all the exciting updates to West Hunt in today's patch!

Don't forget, the [b]Steam Autmun Sale[/b] has started! West Hunt and its DLC are now on-sale for a limited time! Bring your friends, it's the perfect time to recruit some new Sheriffs,.. or Outlaws to town!

[h2]Major New Features:[/h2]

[h3][b]Player Report[/b][/h3]

We've implemented an in-game reporting system. At the end of a match, players can report one or multiple players for cheating, voice chat abuse, etc:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40863214/bba7067d04313e1a18d5740b9140fcd3976feffd.gif[/img]

Currently, actions taken against abusive players may include a time penalty for joining games, or a temporary ban.

Let's do our best to keep West Hunt a fun and enjoyable experience for everyone!

[h3][b]Custom Room Rules[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40863214/fcd92942935ac32b718a7b87c5f3e9b8026fb57a.gif[/img]
We've had so much fun watching players play custom game with friends. Now add even more mayhem to the mix with more Custom Options:
[list]
[*]Start time for Outlaw
[*]Time to finish mission
[*]Bonus time per mission
[*]Number of shots for sheriff
[*]Allow unbalanced game
[*]Number of tasks
[*]Start game with high Notoriety
[*]Get hint from nearest mailbox
[*]Mailbox Delay
[*]Run Duration
[*]Max Teleportation
[*]Max Shapeshift
[/list]

[h3][b]Added kill log:[/b][/h3]
A much requested feature, a kill log has been added to the UI!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40863214/7ca5313d47b219e3fe763b6e574050d9cecb6f3e.png[/img]
---------

[h2]Profanity name-checking:[/h2]
We have implemented the blocking of display names [b]that contain profanity[/b].

[i]Any previous players whose display names are not appropriate or contain swear words, will have 10 days to change it before our system changes these names to random names.[/i]

---------
[h2]Other Changes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed some spawn point issues
[*] Some balancing and level design changes:
[list]
[*]More random locations for NPC spawns have been added
[*]The locations of certain mailboxes have changed
[*]During freeze-time, the door of the sheriff's office is now closed
[*]Collider and navigation improvement
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40863214/e0ae12430963f6f004c760821f6bbe71a55ca99e.gif[/img]
[*] Various Bug Fixes and Network Optimizations
[/list]

We'll catch ya'll in town!

notes.title: West Hunt Q1 Update - Mexico City
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40863214/f04a1786f6a7225ee5b2c13449c7d7c09575df19.png[/img]

The West is expanding, and our new Mexico City map is bustling with activity! It won't be long before some Outlaws start making trouble.

Sheriffs and Outlaws can now taunt or distract each other with different sounds. Outlaws can also leave spray paint sigils around town to distract the Sheriff and keep them off their trail.

Get your running boots on, because Outlaws will now have the ability to run for up to 10s after successfully completing a task. Careful when you use it!

We're also excited to add more custom game parameters for our community as well! You'll soon be able to invite more friends to join in on the fun with 3v3 and 3v2 options in Custom Games!

Exclusive skins will soon be available for content creators of different platforms! Stay tuned for more details on how to get them!

In addition to all these exciting new features will come some balancing updates as well! 

And don’t forget you can come up with your own custom alias in your profile for only a few coins. You have enough from robbing the bank right?

All in all it’s looking mighty lively in the Old West, and Mexico City has plenty to offer if you’re ready to shoot your shot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40863214/9098e9f5fa484964c8ceb4067efcaa320f3e6ce0.png[/img]

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Maps:
[list]
[*] New Map: Mexico City.
[/list]
[*] Maps Balancing:
[list]
[*] Town: redesigned the train station platform access, doubled the “Planting the Bomb” mission area, and changed some mission positions.
[*] Fortress: fixed some colliders, rebalanced map
[/list]
[*] Sheriff Warnings:
[list]
[*] Sheriff can now use a variety of voice lines to taunt the outlaw
[/list]
[*] Outlaw Distraction tools:
[list]
[*] Spray: Outlaw can draw sprays on the ground to confuse the Sheriff and leave marks around town
[*] Sound Distraction: Outlaw can make distracting 3D sounds, like a whistle or a fart to taunt the Sheriff. It can be very useful in 2vs2 and 3vs3 games, especially if you make those sounds in a crowd of NPCs.
[/list]
[*] Outlaw new ability: “Run”
[list]
[*] Outlaws can use the Run ability for up to 10 seconds. 
[*] For each finished primary quest, the Outlaw gains 1s of running ability.
[/list]
[*] New Custom Game Parameters
[list]
[*] 3v3 mode
[*] 2v2 mode
[/list]
[*] Ui/Ux Changes:
[list]
[*] Progress rewards are now accessible from Profile and you can filter the rewards.
[*] Shop is now separate from Rewards.
[*] Easy mode selection (1v1/2v2) in queue matchmaking.
[*] Option to change your Nickname in Profile:
[*] Please note that this will be a paid option for $0.99
[/list]
[*] Exclusive Twitch/TikTok/YouTube Skins. 
[list]
[*] More details on how to obtain these skins will be provided soon
[/list]
[*] Updated Localization and Controller support.
[*] Added feature to redeem voucher codes
[list]
[*] We intend to use this feature to offer codes for exclusive cosmetics and other in-game items in the future
[/list]
[*] Updated the Leaderboard scoring formula.
[*] Various Bug fixes and improvements
[/list]

Thank you so much for enjoying West Hunt. It’s been an incredible game to work on and we’re so excited to bring you these new features and help our community grow!

-The Wandering Wizard and New Gen Team

notes.title: Patch 0.15: some changes
notes.content:
Howdy,

In this update, we made some changes to the notoriety/mailing system.

[b]The time before receiving a mail hint depends on the outlaw's notoriety :[/b]

-The higher the notoriety level, the faster the mail will get to the Sheriff's mailbox.
-The more you are sneaky and keep your notoriety low, the more your mails will come with a delay to the Sheriff.

[b]Another change in the favor of the Sheriff is, when the outlaw's notoriety is high (Level3) the mails will be received in the nearest mailbox.[/b]
